operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm check:deployment-spec && pnpm run verify
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md and RUN-LOCALLY.md: pause writes and scheduled work, retain exact source and private settings, use rer export for a local copy or rer run backup:hosted for a hosted copy, restore into fresh empty resources, re-export and compare domain records and photos, then verify owner access before routing traffic. Preserve applied migration names and bytes.
